fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck/trailer yard on the south side is fully enclosed by chain-link fence. Street View (pano 40.38332,-84.37285) shows a rolling/sliding gate in the fence across the truck entrance lane.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth at the gate - Street View shows only signage ('NO PARKING') at the fenced gate, no 1-3-vehicle structure beside the lane.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but unstaffed - implies badge/kiosk/remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Fenced yard holds many trailers parked in rows (drop yard); estimated 60 visible, banded 25-50 of dedicated drop stalls.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock face on the west side of the east DC building with trailers backed in (~25-30 doors), plus dock positions on the older plant face; total ~38, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large fenced yard interior provides deep stacking room inside the gate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single integrated plant with an attached east DC expansion and a southwest fuel/maintenance support area - treated as one facility, buildingCount 3 counts the support/maintenance structures.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery; possible but unconfirmed.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved interior yard between trailer rows and dock doors offers ample inside staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site - the plant abuts a residential subdivision on the north but open farmland on the south, east, and west; small-town setting -> Rural.

citations.claim: Danone North America's own locations page lists this plant at "216 Southgate Drive Minster, OH 45865". Our roster address for this record is "216 Southgate Drive, Minster, OH 45865", which matches at street level, and the record's coordinates were geocoded from that address.

divestitureCheck.method: Danone's own locations page is its current operating list, so presence on it is positive evidence the plant is still running. Cross-checked against the 2026 restructuring, which named Bridgeton NJ as the closure and named Mount Crawford, Dallas and Jacksonville as receiving its volume.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the current company locations page; not closed or divested

sources.covers: the 2026 Danone North America manufacturing restructuring and the single US plant closure it produced

verification.claimScope: address-level identity from the operator's own published facility list, plus a geocode of that address. Not an independent parcel survey.
verification.rationale: CONFIRMED: Danone North America publishes this plant on its own locations page with a full street address, and that address matches this record's roster address at street level.
